latest.title: A Bernstein problem for translating solutions to the mean curvature flow
latest.abstract:
We study entire graphical translating solutions of the mean curvature flow, \[ \operatorname{div}\!\left( rac{
abla G}{\sqrt{1+|
abla G|^2}}ight) = rac{1}{\sqrt{1+|
abla G|^2}} \qquad	ext{in }\mathbb R^N. \] Every such graph is mean-convex, since its mean curvature is the vertical component of its unit normal. In dimension two, mean-convex translating solitons are convex, and an entire graphical translator is therefore the rotationally symmetric bowl soliton. In higher dimensions Wang constructed non-rotational entire convex translating graphs. We prove that a further loss of rigidity occurs at the Bernstein dimension: for every $N\ge 8$ there exists a one-parameter family of entire graphical translators that are mean-convex but not convex. The construction starts from the Bombieri--De Giorgi--Giusti (BDG) entire minimal graph in $\mathbb R^8$ and develops a singular perturbation theory for the translator equation around it. The main new feature is a transition layer near Simons' cone: the translating term breaks the odd symmetry of the minimal graph, and after a suitable recentering the matching problem is governed by a parabolic inner equation. A detailed analysis of this layer, together with weighted Jacobi theory on the BDG graph and global barriers, yields the desired entire solutions.
latest.workSummary: 构造高维 mean curvature flow 的 entire graphical translators：先以 BDG 非平面 minimal graph 为基底，建立 Jacobi 逆和加权 Schauder 估计，再通过内外层匹配和全局有序势垒得到一参数 translator 族。
latest.breakthrough: 在 $N\ge 8$ 的高维中把非平面 BDG 图形修正为 entire translating solutions，形成 Bernstein 型非仿射族。
latest.limitations: 维数、对称性 $O(4)\times O(4)$ 和小参数范围严格；translator 构造依赖 BDG 输入，不涵盖任意维数或无对称图形。

steps.claim: BDG 图形和其 Jacobi 场提供非平面基准及正性。
steps.route: 将 $O(4)\times O(4)-$不变 BDG graph 写成 $\Gamma $ 上的函数，分析端点展开和正 Jacobi 场；最大值原理给出线性化算子的基本控制。
steps.evidence: 第 2 节 Theorem 2.4、Lemma 2.5、Corollary 2.6（PDF 第 8--14 页）。

steps.claim: 外区的非线性误差可由加权 Jacobi 逆消除。
steps.route: 在大半径区域展开 translator 方程，先解 borderline linear correction，再用 weighted Schauder 估计控制二次/三次余项；快速 Jacobi inverse 给出唯一校正。
steps.evidence: 第 4--5 节 Lemma 4.2、Proposition 5.1、Lemmas 5.2--5.10（PDF 第 27--47 页）。

steps.claim: 内层 profile 与外层修正可在重叠区匹配。
steps.route: 对缩放内变量构造 inner profile，用精确 homogeneous symbol 和 coefficient matching 调整外层参数；重叠区误差按 $\epsilon $ 次序相消。
steps.evidence: 第 5--6 节 Lemmas 5.4--5.6、Lemma 6.1（PDF 第 39--51 页）。

steps.claim: 全局有序势垒夹逼产生真正的 translator。
steps.route: 把 inner/outer 近似拼接为 global sub/supersolutions，利用 ordered barriers 和 Perron/极限方法取 $\epsilon \to 0$，得到 Theorem 7.3/8.1 的 entire graph。
steps.evidence: 第 7--8 节 Theorem 7.3、Proposition 8.1（PDF 第 51--62 页）。

latest.aiEvidence: 作者明确说明使用 ChatGPT 仅辅助语言编辑和论文表达，数学思想、论证和结论均由作者负责。
latest.aiEvidenceSource: PDF 第 61 页 AI 使用声明（文本行约 3142--3145）。
latest.priorityReason: 论文聚焦色散方程，主要进展属于解的构造；排序综合考虑其与 PDE 机制、可复用估计、正则性和长时间行为的相关程度。
